meta.name: paid-ads-review
meta.description: Produce a read-only, evidence-based paid-media performance review across connected platforms or supplied exports. Use for weekly or monthly reports, scorecards, performance, CPA, ROAS, CTR, spend trends, pacing, or conversion-tracking health.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成跨平台广告投放绩效报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要定期查看付费广告表现
copy.tagline_en: Generate cross-platform paid ads performance reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need regular paid media performance reviews

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成只读的付费广告绩效审查：汇总各平台花费、转化、CPA、ROAS、CTR，与上期对比，指出主要贡献因素、最大风险和一条建议行动，不直接改账户。
howto.when: 当用户要求做每周或每月广告绩效回顾，或要求查看 CPA、ROAS、CTR 等指标，或检查转化追踪健康时触发。

say.text: 请生成上周广告绩效回顾，重点看 CPA 和 ROAS。
say.note: 会生成各平台指标的只读报告。

say.text: 对比本月和上月各平台的花费趋势，指出主要变化。
say.note: 会给出对比和可能原因。

say.text: 检查转化追踪是否完整，标出缺失的数据。
say.note: 会列出追踪限制和阻断项。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude produces a read-only paid-media performance review: it aggregates spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS, and CTR across platforms, compares them to the prior period, and highlights the top contributor, major risk, and one recommended next action without changing accounts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a weekly or monthly ad performance review, mentions metrics like CPA, ROAS, CTR, or checks conversion-tracking health.

say_en.text: Generate last week's ad performance review, focusing on CPA and ROAS.
say_en.note: Produces a read-only report with platform metrics.

say_en.text: Compare this month's spend trends with last month across platforms and note major changes.
say_en.note: Gives a comparison and possible drivers.

say_en.text: Check if conversion tracking is complete and flag missing data.
